name: structToSorted
description:
Returns a struct sorted by the top level keys in a structure.
Sorts using alphabetic or numeric sorting.
syntax: structToSorted( struct base, [any sortTypeOrSortFunc], [string sortOrder], [boolean localeSensitive] )

params.name: base
params.description: A structure with one field (an associative array).

params.name: sortTypeOrSortFunc
params.description:
The following sort types are available:

- numeric: sorts numbers
- text: sorts text alphabetically, taking case into account (case sensitive, default)
- textNoCase: sorts text alphabetically, without regard to case (case insensitive)

or a function to be used as a comparator (introduced 6.2.1)

`function(key1, key2)`

params.name: sortOrder
params.description:
Sort direction:

- asc (default): ascending (a to z) sort order
- desc: descending (z to a) sort order
